correctness.rationale: For Sarikyan's smooth complex (2,2,2) canonical cover, the source gives the eight isolated fixed points. Expanding the normal-bundle formula gives the cubic Chern coefficient 35-126+168-80=-3; the degree is eight, so the Euler characteristic is -24. Weak Lefschetz and duality leave four one-dimensional even groups and no odd groups except H^3, so b3=28. A finite-order holomorphic action linearizes at a fixed point; isolatedness excludes a +1 direction and the real Lefschetz index is +1. The traces on the even groups are +1. Thus the odd trace is 4-8=-4 and the ordered multiplicities are (12,16). Adjunction gives K_V=O_V(-1); the only pieces in H^3 are conjugate H^{2,1} and H^{1,2}, giving (6,8) on either. The images of 1±sigma on the abelian intermediate Jacobian have these dimensions and their addition has invertible differential, hence is an isogeny. This makes no integral or polarization assertion. The supplied script checks only exact arithmetic; the geometric inputs and the universal argument were checked separately, not certified by the script.
